messages:
Iris (Design): idea: a 'flightboard' row of tiny latency chips for dense fleet views. each chip: p95 big, 8-bin inline mini-hist, sample badge, and chevron for details. target: 3 columns on tablet. thoughts?
Noah (PM): love it for ops. must make regressions obvious at a glance and provide a one-click path to traces. keep interactions keyboard-first.
Devon (Eng): backend can return p95 + 8 bins when pre-aggregated. exact histos on demand. perf caveat: avoid N concurrent heavy queries; lazy-load expanded data.
Ravi (Data): API idea: /metrics/latency?routes[]=...&bins=8&approx=true -> {p95, bins, sample_rate, conf_ms}. show '~' when sample_rate<1 and include conf text.
Maya (A11y): accessibility checklist:
- don't rely on color alone; add icon and textual delta.
- make mini-hists keyboard-focusable; on focus expose textual bin list for screen readers.
- p95 must meet 4.5:1 contrast and have an aria-live region for updates.
Iris (Design): microcopy: primary line "p95 320ms"; secondary tiny "~10% sampled" when applicable. badge aria-label "Approximate values: sampling enabled". expanded panel includes full heatmap, percentiles, and "Open traces" CTA.
Noah (PM): sampling toggle copy suggestion: "Approximate values from 10% sampling. Run exact query for precise metrics (may take up to 30s and increase cost)." Button: "Run exact query"
Devon (Eng): run-exact as async job + poll UI; show a warning modal before starting heavy queries and cap rate per org. cache exact results for 5m.
Ravi (Data): include confidence +/- ms in response so UI shows uncertainty as text (not only visual).
Maya (A11y): uncertainty must be readable by SRs: e.g., "p95 320ms plus or minus 15ms". ensure focus rings and 44px targets for touch.
staging-bot: deployed flightboard-latency-preview to staging: https://staging.redwood/team/dashboards
Iris (Design): I'll upload compact + expanded mocks with keyboard flows and alt text in Figma by EOD. please flag any missing API fields now.
